test_protobuf_message_serialization: test protobuf message serialization and deserialization against golden data for proto2 and proto3
test_repeated_field_operations: test repeated field operations including append, insert, sort, pop, and merge on scalar and composite fields
test_oneof_field_semantics: test oneof field semantics including WhichOneof, HasField, ClearField, and merge behavior
test_map_field_operations: test proto3 map field operations including get, set, delete, merge, iteration, and deterministic serialization
test_float_edge_cases: test extreme float and double values including infinity, NaN, and high precision printing
